name: Field Service Dispatch Agent
headline: Give dispatchers better options without letting the model move a crew
summary: Turn synthetic service requests, zone capacity, certification evidence, and emergency context into dispatcher-reviewed options while keeping every job, route, message, inventory record, and field action unchanged.
capabilities: Detect outages via real-time IoT sensors, prioritizing critical facilities
Dispatch nearest crews and reroute in-progress jobs automatically
Provide real-time dashboards and automated customer notifications
Optimize inventory staging and handle crew assignments
value: Improves visibility into priority, capacity, and skill-match evidence.
Supports more consistent dispatcher review of emergency and routine work.
Protects field safety by keeping assignment, routing, notification, and execution in approved systems.

notice.text: Demo with sample data only. It is not connected to your organization's data, and it should not be.

scenarios.title: Field Operations Manager: Job dashboard
scenarios.prompt: What does tomorrow's job list look like by crew, and which crews are on standby?

scenarios.title: Service Director: Schedule optimization
scenarios.prompt: I need help optimizing our field technician schedules for tomorrow. We have 15 service calls.

scenarios.title: Dispatch Coordinator: Crew route and skill match
scenarios.prompt: Yes, show me Crew A-1's detailed route

scenarios.title: Emergency Duty Manager: Emergency response draft
scenarios.prompt: URGENT: Major power outage downtown - 1,200 customers affected. Dispatch emergency crews now!

scenarios.title: Control Room Operator: Live outage status
scenarios.prompt: Yes, give me live updates and customer impact

scenarios.title: Reliability Engineer: Post-incident review
scenarios.prompt: The outage is resolved. Show me the post-incident review and how we prevent the next one.

scenarios.title: Operations Analyst: Work orders and monthly report
scenarios.prompt: Yes, create the work orders and show me the monthly operations report
